definitions.gloss: perception; sensation; awareness through the senses
definitions.explanation: The ability to perceive through the senses (sight, hearing, touch, taste, smell), or the act of perceiving something. Used in both everyday and scientific/medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}みを{知覚|ちかく}する。
{知覚|ちかく}{過敏|かびん}で{冷|つめ}たいものが{歯|は}にしみる。
examples.english: Due to tooth sensitivity, cold things sting my teeth.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}の{知覚|ちかく}には{限界|げんかい}があり、{見|み}えないものも{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Human perception has its limits, and there are many things we cannot see.

notes: Not to be confused with homophones {地殻|ちかく} (earth's crust) or {近|ちか}く (nearby). In dentistry, {知覚|ちかく}{過敏|かびん} (tooth sensitivity / hypersensitivity) is a very common usage. In psychology and philosophy, {知覚|ちかく} refers to the cognitive process of interpreting sensory input. Common collocations: {知覚|ちかく}{神経|しんけい} (sensory nerve), {知覚|ちかく}{障害|しょうがい} (perceptual disorder), {視覚|しかく}{知覚|ちかく} (visual perception).
